reviews.review: After I finished my Mass Effect trilogy playthrough, I decided to hop on Andromeda. I wasn't sure at first, because I heard many poor reviews. But since I loved the trilogy, I decided to be open-minded and give it a shot. I wasn't disappointed at all. I loved it a lot. The story was cool, the visuals were amazing, combat was cooler than in the trilogy. But again, the characters were the main reason why the game was so enjoyable. I really loved getting to know each and every one of the squadmates. Out of all the squadmates, Cora was my favourite. At first, she was giving me a mix of Miranda and Jack, but when she let her guard down, she was so sweet yet still professional. Other characters like Vetra, Drack, Jaal and Peebee were amazing, SAM was also a cool addition. I also loved Reyes, such a handsome daredevil. Additionally, I really loved the choices that we could make. This time, we didn't have paragon and renegade options, but 4 different options that I really liked. To sum up, the game was really amazing and I wasn't disappointed after all those bad reviews, so I recommend playing the game after finishing the trilogy. It's worth it!

The game is okay. I did end up recommending it, but it's a so-so decision. There are a lot of bugs, some of them even game braking. Sometimes when exiting the program it even lock up the OS somehow.

Storyline is full of clichés (like remnant and all the remnant tech including even sound effects, feel like a straight rip off from Halo). Characters are ok, but not overly interesting (i only liked Vetra and Drack if i'm honest). Also quite annoying that you can't skip travel animations (like jumping to another system or take off and land from planets.)
Character creation is a joke, you either go with the baseline characters, or you basically create an potato.

But i did end up finishing it with 98% completion, so had some fun along the way. Replay value? not sure, but i definitely don't feel like pushing through it again for a while. But if you have nothing to play and you get it at a discount, go for it, you might end up liking it.
We'll bang ok but if it was bad. Play it if you're a Mass Effect fan. Don't play it if you're not a Mass Effect fan
